Rails Capability Map

A capability-based learning map for modern Ruby on Rails — core conventions through AI-assisted shipping, current to Rails 8.x. Each capability has a situation, curated resources, and a practice exercise. Start with Capability 1 or jump to whatever your project needs most.

1. Rails Core & Conventions is the gateway, feeding 2. Active Record & Data — the foundation for the 3. Hotwire frontend, 4. Background Jobs, and 9. Performance, which all build on the data layer. 5. Security & Auth pairs with 6. Testing — the correctness pair — and testing in turn feeds 7. Growing the Codebase (you can only refactor what tests protect). 7 feeds 8. Ship & Operate, which closes the loop back into 9. Performance in production. 10. AI Partner is a force multiplier across all of it.

Books (O'Reilly Learning)

Specific chapters are linked in each capability’s Go Deeper section.

  • Agile Web Development with Rails 8 — Sam Ruby & Dave Thomas
  • The Rails and Hotwire Codex — Ayush Newatia
  • Layered Design for Ruby on Rails Applications — Vladimir Dementyev
  • Rails Scales! — Cristian Planas
  • High Performance PostgreSQL for Rails — Andrew Atkinson
  • Hotwire Native for Rails Developers — Joe Masilotti
  • Programming Ruby (5th ed., 'The Pickaxe') — Noel Rappin & Dave Thomas
